construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Exact-key JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic=true, human_review_required=true, research_questions, records
shared_schema.record: record_id, kind, resource, evidence; synthetic typed IDs only

entities.patient_record: FHIR-style Patient with synthetic diagnosis codes and finite bounded laboratory values
entities.clinical_note: FHIR-style DocumentReference with labeled synthetic clinical note text and patient reference
entities.prior_authorization_request: FHIR-style draft Claim with prior-authorization purpose and labeled synthetic request text

shared_schema.evidence: question matching a declared research question, stance support/oppose/uncertain, exact source quote
shared_schema.output: Input envelope preserved, plus status, synthesis, audit_trail, autonomous_clinical_decisions=false
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error and a sanitized error message; CLI exits 2
shared_schema.validation: validate_document is used at both input and output boundaries; rejects unknown fields, identifier patterns, missing synthetic/review flags, malformed references, ungrounded citations and inconsistent output

cross_stage_handoffs: Single Research stage: validated immutable records -> question-specific evidence aggregation -> disagreements and unresolved questions -> audited, validated JSON output

behavior.determinism: Stable input-order citations and sequence-numbered audits; no clocks, randomness, network or providers
behavior.synthesis: Groups supplied evidence by declared question across documents; retains exact source quotes and record/evidence references
behavior.disagreement: Both supporting and opposing stances explicitly flag conflict; no majority vote or clinical inference
behavior.unresolved: Missing evidence, single-source evidence, explicit uncertainty and conflicts generate review issues
behavior.de_identification: Rejects direct identifier fields and common free-text identifier patterns; accepts only synthetic typed IDs and explicitly labeled fixture text. No real names, birth dates or MRNs in fixtures
behavior.human_review: Always required; no diagnosis, treatment, dose or authorization decisions generated
behavior.audit: Every source registration and derived report creation has an ordered create event with SHA-256 content digest and null before-state; source records are never mutated
behavior.fixture: Fictitious Synthea-style patient with diagnosis E11.9 and synthetic lab result; opposing documentation statements and an uncertain therapy-duration statement
behavior.limitations: Constrained demonstrative HIPAA de-identification rules, not certification or exhaustive free-text PHI detection

included: One offline deterministic deep-research synthesis stage
One patient per run with multiple linked documents
Exact citation grounding, explicit disagreements and unanswered questions
Shared schema and validation, mandatory human review and per-record audit
Bounded input sizes and JSON/file error handling
excluded: Live retrieval, model calls, optional LLM extension and external dependencies
Real patient data or production HIPAA compliance claims
Full FHIR conformance or Synthea file import
Automatic semantic stance extraction or verification of source truth
Persistent record updates, audit signatures, access control and enterprise deployment
